Getting Help with WJPr

Source: SUPPORT.md

Documentation

Before opening an issue, check the available documentation:

  • Documentation site - Complete package documentation
  • Function reference - Documentation for every function
  • Data preparation - How to structure your data
  • Chart gallery - Visual examples

Getting Help

Usage questions

  1. Read the function documentation with ?wjp_function
  2. Search the existing issues
  3. Open a question issue

Reporting bugs

Use the bug report template and include:

  • A minimal reproducible example
  • The full error message
  • Your R and WJPr versions (sessionInfo())

Requesting features

Use the feature request template and describe:

  • The use case
  • The proposed solution
  • An example of how it would be used

Contributing

Want to contribute code? Read our contribution guide.
